task_description: Build SnapDeliver, an MNC-grade photo delivery SaaS monorepo for wedding photographers optimized for Nepal market. Includes: Prisma/pgvector data layer, NestJS API with R2 presigned uploads, Tauri desktop with offline-first queue, BullMQ worker with Sharp 6-preset processing and InsightFace extraction, Next.js web portals (dashboard + guest portal with selfie face search and native share).
